name: Contract Registration Statement V 04
definition: The ContractRegistrationStatement message is sent by the registration agent to the reporting party, in response to a request or at a pre-agreed date, to send a statement of the operations related to the registered contract subject to currency control.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Characteristics shared by all individual items included in the message.

Statement.name: Statement
Statement.definition: Provides the contract registration statement, which includes all journals on the activities related to the contract.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
